title: 동산ㆍ채권 등의 담보에 관한 법률 시행령 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
title_original: 동산ㆍ채권 등의 담보에 관한 법률 시행령
full_text:
Article 3 (Notice of Direct Appropriation of Collateral, etc.)
(1) Where, when giving notice under Article 23 (1) or (2) of the Act, the secured creditor considers that there will be no amount remaining after deduction of the amount of the secured claim from the appraised value or estimated sale proceeds of the collateral, the secured creditor shall state that fact.
(2) Where, when giving notice under Article 23 (1) or (2) of the Act, there are several items of collateral, the secured creditor shall state the claim and costs intended to be extinguished in proportion to the appraised value or estimated sale proceeds of each item of collateral.
(3) Notice under Article 23 (1) or (2) of the Act may be given by mail or any other appropriate means.
(4) Notice under Article 23 (1) or (2) of the Act to an interested person registered in the security register as a right holder in relation to the collateral may be given to that person's address recorded in the register.
(5) Where a secured creditor, without negligence, is unable to ascertain the whereabouts of a debtor or another interested person known to the secured creditor and therefore cannot give notice by the method referred to in paragraph (3), the secured creditor may give notice in accordance with the provisions of the Civil Procedure Act governing service by public notice.
